sources.title: Queryn adapter — bge-m3 → fastembed-bge-small - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Translates an embedding produced by bge-m3 into the embedding space of fastembed-bge-small, so a corpus already embedded with bge-m3 can be served against a fastembed-bge-small index without re-embedding it. Part of the Queryn embedding-translation engine.

sources.title: BGE-M3 — BGE documentation
sources.snippet: BGE-M3 is a compound and powerful embedding model distinguished for its versatility in: Multi-Functionality: It can simultaneously perform the three common retrieval functionalities of embedding model: dense retrieval, multi-vector retrieval, and sparse retrieval.

sources.title: GitHub - qdrant/fastembed: Fast, Accurate, Lightweight Python library ...
sources.snippet: FastEmbed is a lightweight, fast, Python library built for embedding generation. We support popular text models. Please open a GitHub issue if you want us to add a new model. The default text embedding (TextEmbedding) model is Flag Embedding, presented in the MTEB leaderboard. It supports "query" and "passage" prefixes for the input text.
